# Suntar Bhavan

Suntar Bhavan is a Jain dharamshala on Hastgiri Road near Taleti in Palitana, Gujarat 364270, India. Established in 2021, it offers AC and non-AC rooms, attached bathrooms, hot and cold water, a Jain Bhojanshala, a temple, free parking and assistance for pilgrims.

## Canonical pages

- Home: https://www.suntarbhavan.in/
- Rooms: https://www.suntarbhavan.in/rooms
- Jain Bhojanshala and meal timings: https://www.suntarbhavan.in/bhojanshala
- Facilities: https://www.suntarbhavan.in/facilities
- Property photos: https://www.suntarbhavan.in/gallery
- Verified address and direct contact: https://www.suntarbhavan.in/visit
